description: This file defines a static class 'GrainTypePrefix' that provides constants, span representations, and helper methods for identifying different types of grains and clients within the Orleans framework, such as system types, grain services, clients, and legacy grains.

methods.name: IsClient
methods.description: Checks if the given GrainType is a client type by verifying if it starts with the client prefix bytes.

methods.name: IsSystemTarget
methods.description: Checks if the given GrainType is a system target type by verifying if it starts with the system target prefix bytes.

methods.name: IsLegacyGrain
methods.description: Checks if the given GrainType is a legacy grain type by verifying if it starts with the legacy grain prefix bytes.

methods.name: IsGrainService
methods.description: Checks if the given GrainType is a grain service type by verifying if it starts with the grain service prefix bytes.

methods.name: IsClient (for GrainId)
methods.description: Determines if the GrainId represents a client by checking its type with IsClient method.

methods.name: IsSystemTarget (for GrainId)
methods.description: Determines if the GrainId represents a system target by checking its type with IsSystemTarget method.
